raphazarus.title: INTERROGATION — RAPHAZARUS'S SOLDIERS
raphazarus.description: The room is bare concrete. A man of impossible age watches you without blinking. His soldiers stand behind him, motionless. There's no form, no procedure. Just his eyes and your silence.
raphazarus.demandLabel: Raphazarus wants to know what you were doing in the Lost Arc.

emporium.title: INTERROGATION — EMPORIUM SERVICES
emporium.description: A clean room, clinically lit. The agent across from you smiles. That's the worst sign. The Emporium has resources. And time. And a very broad definition of the word 'confession.'
emporium.demandLabel: The services want to know about your activities in the imperial zone.

gardiens.title: INTERROGATION — GUARDIANS OF THE EMPIRE
gardiens.description: The colonel watches you from across a metal table. No paperwork. No visible recording. The Guardians have their own methods — and their own definitions of justice.
gardiens.demandLabel: The Guardians want you to justify your presence in the military zone.

local.title: INTERROGATION — LOCAL AUTHORITIES
local.description: A nondescript room. Men in generic uniforms. They have a warrant and no patience. The question isn't whether you'll talk — it's when.
local.demandLabel: They want to know who you are and what you were doing there.

introText: Before the cell, they insist on 'verifying you're a normal citizen.' A series of {{total}} questions. Answer at least {{pass}} correctly and you walk out free. Most are trivial… but some have no possible answer. Good luck.

quiz.impossibleNote: (Nobody could reasonably answer that one. It was the trap.)
quiz.passMessage: You answered {{score}}/{{total}} questions correctly. The interrogator sighs, disappointed they can't keep you. "Model citizen, apparently." They let you go.
quiz.passJournal: I survived {{faction}}'s cultural interrogation ({{score}}/{{total}}). They couldn't keep me.
quiz.failMessage: Only {{score}}/{{total}} correct answers. "Either you're a spy or you're uneducated. Either way, cell." They take you away.

choices.waiting: They're waiting. The silence has lasted too long to be comfortable. You have options — none of them good.
choices.talkResult: You talk. Not everything — but enough. They seem satisfied in a way that doesn't reassure you. They release you after two hours. Your credits were 'checked.' -{{amount}} cr confiscated. -10 rep.
choices.talkJournal: I cooperated with {{faction}}'s interrogation. They took my credits. I walked out free — which is already something.
choices.denySuccess: You deny everything consistently. They have nothing solid. After an interminable time, they release you with a warning. You walk out shaking but free. -5 rep.
choices.denySuccessJournal: I denied everything at the interrogation. They had nothing solid. I walked out free but shaking.
choices.denyMidFail: Your denial irritates them. They decide you look guilty of something else. You spend a few days in a cell while they 'verify.' -15 rep.
choices.denyMidFailJournal: I denied everything at the interrogation. They put me in a cell while they 'verified.' They'll verify for a long time.
choices.denyBadFail: They have more information than you thought. Your denial convinces them you're hiding something serious. Long detention. -20 rep.
choices.denyBadFailJournal: They had more information on me than I thought. My denial did nothing. Long cell.
choices.bribeSuccess: The money changes hands discreetly. Nobody says a word. You're out in ten minutes. -{{amount}} cr.
choices.bribeSuccessJournal: I bought my freedom at {{station}}. {{amount}} credits. The agent didn't even look up.
choices.bribeFail: The agent pockets it. And calls for backup. 'For aggravated corruption.' You paid for nothing. -{{amount}} cr. Cell.
choices.bribeFailJournal: I tried to bribe the agent. He pocketed it and called for backup. I paid for a cell.
choices.resist: Resist physically — attempt an immediate escape (15%)
choices.resistSuccess: A violent move, an opening, a corridor. You run like you've never run. You're out. You don't understand how yet. +20 rep (people are talking about you).
choices.resistSuccessJournal: I escaped from an interrogation. A move, an opening, a corridor. I still don't understand how.
choices.resistFail: The attempt goes wrong immediately. There were four of them. You'll never know more. -HP, reinforced security cell.
choices.resistFailJournal: I physically resisted the interrogation. There were four of them. I woke up in a reinforced security cell.
choices.betray: Rat someone else out (+500 cr, -25 rep, 'informant' tag)
choices.betrayResult: You give a name. Not yours — someone else's. Someone you crossed paths with. Someone who asked for nothing. They take note. You walk out. -25 rep. 'Informant' tag.
choices.betrayJournal: I gave a name that wasn't mine at the interrogation. I don't know what they did with that name. I don't want to know.

classPerk.reveal: 💻 Hack the terminal — reveal the answer
